direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.question: How much does it cost to respray a kitchen in Ireland?
direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.answer: In Ireland, respraying a small kitchen (up to 10 doors and drawer fronts) costs €700 to €1,000. A standard medium family kitchen (10 to 20 doors) costs €1,250 to €2,000, and a large kitchen with an island and tall larder run (20 to 35+ doors) costs €2,000 to €4,500. That saves 75% to 85% compared with a €10,000 to €20,000 new fitted kitchen.

direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.question: Do you spray the doors on site or take them away?
direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.answer: Specialist kitchen resprayers do both: all removable doors, drawer fronts and kickboards are unscrewed and taken to a temperature-controlled, dust-extracted workshop spray booth for degreasing, sanding, priming and 2-pack spraying. Then the team spends 1 day on site masking your room and spraying the fixed end panels, pelmets, cornices and face frames so everything matches.

direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.question: Can you respray a dark solid oak or orange pine kitchen?
direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.answer: Yes — solid oak, ash, maple and pine kitchens are the single best candidates for respraying because the timber doors and hinges are built to last decades. Two coats of high-build blocking primer seal the wood tannins so no yellow knots bleed through, leaving a smooth satin finish while keeping a subtle whisper of natural woodgrain.

direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.question: Can peeling vinyl-wrapped or foil kitchen doors be resprayed?
direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.answer: You cannot spray on top of peeling vinyl, because the foil will keep lifting underneath the paint. However, because the core underneath is solid routed MDF, a sprayer can heat-strip the vinyl film off completely, solvent-clean the glue, seal the raw MDF with high-build primer and spray it like new (stripping adds €250 to €600).

direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.question: How long does a sprayed kitchen finish last?
direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.answer: When sprayed in a booth with commercial 2-pack polyurethane (2K PU) or acid-catalyst (AC) cabinet lacquer — not ordinary hardware-store wall or trim paint — a kitchen respray typically lasts 8 to 12+ years in a busy family home and can be wiped clean with warm soapy water.

direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.question: Can you colour-match Farrow & Ball or Colourtrend shades?
direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.answer: Yes. Commercial cabinet lacquer tinting systems colour-match any shade from Colourtrend, Farrow & Ball, Little Greene, Fleetwood or the RAL chart, and mix it in 10% matte, 20%–25% satin (the most popular wipe-clean kitchen sheen) or 30% eggshell.
